profile_text.body:
SenseTime is a Hong Kong-headquartered public company, founded in 2014 and traded under ticker 0020.HK. The company describes itself as building SenseNova native multimodal large language models and SenseCore AI cloud infrastructure for enterprise AI digital transformation. Its site cites an IDC report, "China AI Software Market Semi-Annual Tracker, 2025 H2," as showing SenseTime has led China's Vision AI market share for 10 consecutive years.

The product entry for SenseTime SenseChat describes it as a Chinese multimodal LLM with computer vision integration, and notes that cross-border data review is advised. The company's site also says SenseTime is grounded in academic excellence and forward-looking vision, and that it advances AI research into scalable, real-world applications across industries.
